//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the inline TEXT component (svelte typography/Text.svelte, keen Typography.text/1). SCOPE = a flat inline `<span>` for coloured inline text. Core's blessed inline-colour shape is a BARE <span> carrying a `.text-{variant}` SEMANTIC COLOUR utility (snippets/typography.html lines 111-115: `<span class="text-primary">`, `<span class="text-success">` …). These are the colour-only `.text-*` utilities (NOT the pa-text paragraph component) — core ships exactly five: primary, success, danger, warning, info (there is NO text-secondary/-muted/-light/-dark). With no variant the span is CLASS-LESS (the `<code>`/heading precedent). The only other inputs are a `title` tooltip attribute and a class passthrough. See code.json for the class-less-default model and label.json for the variant model.

propsVocabulary.variant: semantic colour primary|success|danger|warning|info → text-{variant} (colour-only utility). Omit → bare <span> with no class.
propsVocabulary.title: HTML title attribute (hover tooltip) — a real attribute, not a class
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (class passthrough — not a core feature)

goldenConventions: Structural + the one `title` attribute convention. The span carries a `text-{variant}` class only when a variant is set, otherwise NO class. `title` is emitted only when provided. Slot content is a plain text token so the diff checks tag + class + attribute + nesting, not rich content. Class-token order + whitespace + attribute order are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. The INLINE text component uses the colour-only `.text-*` utilities (NOT pa-text--*). Core ships exactly five: text-primary, text-success, text-danger, text-warning, text-info. The block name here is `text` — a bare type/utility prefix with no `text--*` BEM modifiers and no `text__*` elements (the `.text-{variant}` utilities are flat), so the axis-1 reverse checks find nothing to claim and the 'vacuous scope' note is EXPECTED (the component's canonical default is a class-less bare <span>). `title` + the slot + class passthrough are structural → produces: null.

title.note: HTML title attribute (tooltip) — not a class

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: The inline text span has no BEM block/modifier classes of its own (the colour utilities are flat `.text-*`), so there is nothing for the axis-1 reverse check to claim.

scenarios.name: with-title
scenarios.note: The title attribute rides alongside the colour utility.

scenarios.note: Class passthrough appended after the variant class.
